item.title: Blender 5.3 Ships with Native 3D Gaussian Splatting Support
item.description:

item.title: Google Ships Gemini 4 Carbon Targeting Long-Horizon Agent Tasks
item.description:
Google released Gemini 4 Carbon just two weeks after Argon, positioning it for sustained long-horizon tasks. Early testing shows 0% shortcut rate on Terminal-Bench and 0% prompt-injection success on Gray Swan's benchmark, 2x the secure-code rate of Argon, and 88% vulnerability detection on Sec-Bench Pro. Pricing at $2/$10 per million tokens with 95% off cached input makes multi-day agents economically viable.

原文标题：谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Carbon 主打长程任务与安全

item.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Carbon for Cybersecurity and Long-Horizon Agents
item.description:

Carbon sits above Gemini 4 Argon and targets extreme tasks such as complex multi-step coding, debugging, and open-ended scientific research, while Argon remains the default for most software engineering and knowledge work. Carbon was previously released to select cybersecurity defenders through the Fairwind Program.

item.title: Robbyant Open Sources LingBot-Touch Tactile Model for Robots
item.description:
Robbyant has open-sourced LingBot-Touch under Apache 2.0, converting fingertip tactile sensor readings into signals usable by robot control software and filling the gap where cameras cannot sense grip force or slip. The team trained three same-size encoders (5.46M parameters each) on identical touch data; at 4,000 hours, the JEPA variant that predicts masked regions in latent space reached 49.3% top-5 on tactile-to-video retrieval with MAE under 9%, versus just 3.1% for the VAE. The author attributes JEPA's edge to the sparsity and low signal-to-noise ratio of tactile data.

原文标题：Robbyant 开源 LingBot-Touch 触觉模型

Why it matters：开源触觉编码器为机器人补上摄像头缺失的力觉维度，且给出了 JEPA 与 VAE 的对照实验数据。

item.title: DeepMind Agents Formally Prove Signal Code Secure at Processor Level
item.description:
Google DeepMind used teams of Gemini Carbon agents to produce roughly 6.5 million lines of Lean proofs showing that Signal's actual compiled code keeps messages private, verified down to the processor instruction level and checked independently by Lean so no trust in the AI is required. The effort took about four weeks versus years for expert teams, with humans setting security goals and reviewing the ~1% flagged by agents. It is claimed as the first end-to-end formal verification of a widely used protocol at the machine-code level.

原文标题：DeepMind 用 AI 智能体完成 Signal 代码形式化安全证明

Why it matters：首次以 AI 智能体集群完成真实生产协议在处理器指令层的形式化安全证明，兼具方法突破与工程示范价值。

item.title: One Tar Command Builds an Archive With Eight Different Extraction Outcomes
item.description:
A developer crafted a single GNU tar invocation that produces an archive extracting in eight distinct ways depending on the tool used, by exploiting pax extended headers, hard-link semantics and path transformation. The experiment exposes spec ambiguities around hard-link sizes, pax header overrides and UTF-8 filename handling, and has been added as a cross-implementation compatibility test case.

Why it matters：以精巧构造揭示 tar 格式的规范歧义，对归档工具与兼容性测试有实际参考价值。

item.title: Siemens CEO Says AI Transformation May Take Only Seven Years
item.description:
Siemens CEO Roland Busch said in a Nikkei Asia interview that AI will not replace humans directly, but people who use AI will increasingly displace those who do not, arguing current large models are pattern-matching tools without genuine creativity. He said AI's social transformation may take only seven to eight years versus decades for steam and electricity, and that massive AI investment will pay off only when it reaches real-world manufacturing and autonomous robotics.
